user.title: HouseFly
user.description: Watching is free and safe; touching is neither, so they are separate questions. Turn on whole-house watching and it smells everything read-only, which is what makes "something unusual" worth anything — a novelty detector fed six sensors can only notice six kinds of strange. What it may touch stays a short, explicit list, and actuation is off until you turn it on.

data.approach_entities: Ranging sensors it can be approached by (radar, ultrasonic)

error.too_many_inputs: That is more sensors than the antennal lobe has glomeruli. Pick fewer.
error.too_many_outputs: Too many outputs. A fly lands on a few things, not everything.
error.unsafe_output: One or more of those cannot be fly-controlled. Locks, covers, climate, water heaters and anything named like it matters are refused.
error.too_many_approach: Too many ranging sensors. A fly has two eyes, not eight.
